summary: OpenAI published enterprise guidance on managing AI investment (visibility, ROI evaluation, governance, portfolio funding, capacity matching), referencing existing ChatGPT Work admin console features, pricing history since GPT-4, and GPT-5.6 token/time efficiency on a coding benchmark.

practices.reason: The document gives a concrete, implementable methodology for evaluating models by cost per accepted outcome rather than raw token price.
practices.quote: For priority workflows, track cost per accepted outcome . In customer support, that might be a resolved case. In engineering, it might be a tested change that passes review.

practices.reason: The advice to use focused tools, reusable context and explicit stopping conditions is a concrete pattern to reduce loops and wasted spend, but no gain is quantified.
practices.quote: Clear instructions, focused tools, reusable context, and explicit stopping conditions can reduce loops and wasted spend.
